identity.name: CIRCA at Foggy Bottom
identity.notes: The restaurant-issued Foggy Bottom page and its exact linked ChowNow store both identify 2221 I St NW, Washington, DC 20037. Clarendon, Navy Yard, and The Boro have different addresses and are explicitly excluded from the current product boundary.

sources.excerpt: The official CIRCA at Foggy Bottom page gives 2221 I St NW, current hours, and live Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, Cocktails and Wine, Beer, Brunch, Whiskey Flights, and Dessert sections with product descriptions and links to location-specific PDFs and ordering.
The official map distinguishes Foggy Bottom at 2221 I St NW from Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd, Navy Yard at 99 M Street SE, and The Boro at 1675 Silver Hill Drive.

The current Foggy Bottom-linked Spring 2026 lunch PDF contains 43 food products, a dietary-icon legend, the statement that CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment, and a request to notify the server about allergies or dietary restrictions.
The current Foggy Bottom-linked dinner PDF contains 39 food products and repeats the restaurant's dietary-icon legend, gluten-environment caution, and allergy-notification request.
The current Foggy Bottom-linked Spring 2026 brunch PDF contains 44 food products and the same dietary-icon and gluten-environment disclosures.
The current Foggy Bottom Spring 2026 beverage PDF identifies four mocktails and two nonalcoholic beers. Its cocktails, wines, spirits, and alcoholic beers are outside the POC boundary.

A restaurant-issued Foggy Bottom gluten-sensitive guide explains that modified items differ from standard-menu preparations, says CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment, and asks guests to inform staff of allergies so precautions can be considered. It is preserved as supporting evidence, not an allergen-absence matrix.

The official site's Foggy Bottom order link resolves to ChowNow location 34562 at 2221 I St NW. It exposes 44 distinct current food products after popular-item repeats are consolidated; three utensil and condiment controls are excluded as service modifiers.

Targeted searches recovered the exact official location page, its current official menu PDFs, the supporting Foggy Bottom gluten-sensitive guide, and the exact linked ChowNow store. No restaurant-issued comprehensive allergen matrix or ingredient table was found.

attempts.outcome: The official site confirmed the exact location and complete current menu surfaces. It provides menu descriptions and links to icon-bearing PDFs, but no comprehensive product-by-allergen matrix or full ingredient table.

attempts.query: Inspect current Foggy Bottom Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Beverage, and discoverable Gluten Sensitive PDFs plus official-domain document results for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredient, icon, and cross-contact disclosures.

No comprehensive allergen matrix was found. Visual review confirmed that the M icon means can be modified to be gluten sensitive, not milk.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed. Official matrix status is accurately_unavailable, while available direct evidence is still preserved. Positive shellfish/nut icons and literal official ingredients are attached to products; negative dietary icons are retained only as restaurant-level evidence and are not converted into allergen-absence claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The official menu legend distinguishes vegetarian, vegan, dairy-free, contains shellfish, contains nuts, gluten sensitive, and can be modified to be gluten sensitive.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Positive contains-shellfish and contains-nuts icons are preserved with direct item evidence. Dairy-free and gluten-sensitive icons are supported dietary claims but are not converted into categorical allergen absence. The black M icon is a modification marker, not a milk declaration.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: CIRCA states that it is not a gluten-free environment and that individual gluten sensitivity varies.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Preserved separately as restaurant-level gluten cross-contact context. It is not converted into blanket product mayContain labels.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: CIRCA asks guests to notify the server of food allergies or dietary restrictions; its gluten-sensitive guide says staff can make recommendations and consider preparation precautions.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is an accommodation statement, not a guarantee that any product is free of an allergen.

findings.summary: Restaurant-issued and linked-vendor sources consistently identify CIRCA at Foggy Bottom at 2221 I St NW, Washington, DC 20037.
Clarendon, Navy Yard, and The Boro have distinct official addresses and menu pages. Their location-only products are not merged into Foggy Bottom.

The exact Foggy Bottom POC boundary is 79 distinct products across Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Dessert, Zero Proof, nonalcoholic beer, and the linked ChowNow store. ChowNow adds Broccolini and a separately priced Crispy Brussels + Blue side; service controls are excluded.

The 98-row frozen projection merges duplicate HTML/PDF names and sources from all four CIRCA locations. Four rows are out-of-location or alcohol-only records and one row is a heading/product concatenation artifact.

Visual PDF verification establishes that CIRCA's black M icon means can be modified to be gluten sensitive. It does not mean milk; frozen milk labels derived from that icon must be removed unless literal official ingredients independently support milk.

No comprehensive official allergen matrix or full ingredient table was found after all four required searches. Direct positive icons and literal restaurant ingredients are preserved; products without such evidence remain unavailable.

The restaurant explicitly says it is not a gluten-free environment. This cross-contact context and the allergy-notification guidance are preserved separately rather than converted into blanket absence or may-contain claims.

proposedChanges: Replace the 98-row multi-location and duplicate-smeared projection with the 79-product exact Foggy Bottom union from current official and restaurant-linked surfaces.
Segregate Clarendon, Navy Yard, The Boro, alcohol-only entries, and the concatenated menu-heading artifact from the Foggy Bottom application catalog.
Correct the parser's M-icon error: treat M as a gluten-sensitive modification marker, remove unsupported milk labels, and preserve only direct positive icons and literal ingredient evidence.
Preserve CIRCA's not-gluten-free-environment statement and allergy-notification guidance as restaurant-level evidence; leave unsupported allergen absence unavailable.
